reel_check.ANGLE type items (weekly list): yes: each item has its day, name and what lands, from a primary
reel_check.STORY one paragraph: yes: Tuesday: GTA VI pre-load, Apex x Godzilla, the Monster Train 2 add-on, Warhammer Survivors; Thursday: Metaphor on Switch 2 and WARDOGS Season 3
